description: A full-stack SvelteKit web app styled with Tailwind CSS. Pages render ahead of the browser for fast first loads, and each file in the routes folder becomes a page.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a dashboard, a content site, a business app with SSR - built with Svelte
ui.description: SvelteKit + Tailwind. Server-side rendered Svelte app with file-based routing.

sample_prompts: A task management app with drag-and-drop kanban boards and team assignments
A fitness tracker with workout logs, progress charts, and weekly summaries
A restaurant menu builder with categories, items, and pricing
